cases.title: Use an above-shoulder barrier to rehearse a more usable backswing
cases.coaching_finding: Coach finds high/forward hands and insufficient hip turn before steep driver delivery.
cases.coach_reasoning: Barrier constrains top while hip turn provides room, which coach expects to make subsequent shallowing and release easier.

intervention.setup: Padded stick above trail shoulder as shown in coach demonstration.
intervention.cue: Rehearse to top without hitting barrier with hands, arms or club.
intervention.intended_change: Lead arm nearer shoulder plane, hands nearer heel depth with backswing hip turn.
intervention.progression: Only after top is usable, rehearse delivery and normal release/turn; not a stack of simultaneous thoughts.
intervention.limits: No mounting distance, calibrated barrier angle or repetition count supplied.

applicability: Earlier backswing conditions match the source; steep delivery alone does not justify drill.
Do not treat 45 degrees as a universal required hip angle or infer mobility from video.
Same coach has other cases where backswing should be retained.
unknowns: Actual 3D hip rotation, mobility and target-relative path.
Carter drill execution and driver transfer from iron demonstration.
cases.observed_result: Coach demonstration and shot only; Carter has no retest and draw benefit is predicted.

selection.policy_origin: User one-focus preference; retain source sequencing and avoid simultaneous competing thoughts.
selection.reassess: Proposed app check: verify comfortable clearance, earlier hip/hand relationship and aid-free same-club outcome before adding transition work.

measurement_register.value: 45 degrees hip turn at coach demonstrated backswing top
limits: No instrument or calibrated 3D estimate. Backward turn at top, not a measured impact-open angle.

measurement_register.value: Padded shoulder barrier, hand depth and shaft lines, desired draw
limits: No physical setup dimensions or measured ball flight.

source_ambiguities.issue: ASR painted glass is retained in raw transcript; context and physical barrier support pane-of-glass drill interpretation. Hogan attribution is by coach, not independently verified against original text.

cross_source_links.explanation: Tyler's backswing is retained while transition is changed. Carter's earlier hip/hand conditions are selected for a backswing barrier. Same steep result does not identify same treatment.

Mohammad's high top and stronger face are accepted for preferred cut. Carter's full preceding/subsequent sequence is the source condition; a universal high-arm fault rule would erase this distinction.

cross_source_links.relation: Check mechanism as well as prop clearance
cross_source_links.explanation: Eli's drill review shows a prop endpoint can be met through unintended motion. Clearing the shoulder barrier alone would not prove useful hip/arm sequence or shot improvement.

annotation_opportunities: Separate student driver and coach iron clips.
Mark padding/clearance and hip-turn context at top.
Label 45 degrees spoken estimate and draw illustration.
excluded_material: Post title Everyone should try this treated as universal eligibility.
Hogan attribution treated as separately verified history.
Draw graphic counted as measured result.

independent_validation.reason: Source extraction preserves evidence and conditions; a source match and response check are still needed for another golfer.
